Wait, asobject(I) creates the full 3x3 input grid (including zeros) as object. Shift it by block offsets, paint. So each 3x3 block that has a 2 in the input at position (i,j) gets a shifted copy of the entire input grid, including the 2s within it.

row1: 0 2 2
row2: 0 0 0
